title: Colors
description: Brick House brand colours from the logo and the Jekyll site. Gold (#FFC843) is a fill colour: blocks, frames, buttons, and text on Grey or Ink only. Gold Deep is gold for text on White (6:1). Grey is the logo grey darkened to #565656 so white and gold text on it pass 4.5:1; Logo Grey (#6C6C6C) is the original, for the logo and decoration.
